caseName: Director of Prisons v. Court of First Instance
caseNameFull: The Director of Prisons, in Error and v. The Court of First Instance of the Province of Cavite, Tenth Judicial District
summary: In error to and appeal from the Supreme Court of the Philippine Islands.
attorneys: Mr. S. T. Ansell and Mr. C. J. Gurkin for the plaintiff in error and appellant. Mr. C. W. O’Brien for the defendant in error and appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam¡

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Jones v. Montague, 194 U. S. 147; Lewis v. The United States, 216 U. S. 611; Richardson v. McChesney, 218 U. S. 487; Stearns v. Wood, 236 U. S. 75.
